# UD Greek GLCII

Language: [Greek](/el/index.html) (code: `el`)<br/>
Family: IE

This treebank has been part of Universal Dependencies since the UD v2.18 release.

The following people have contributed to making this treebank part of UD: Christina Klironomou, Thelka Pasparaki, Arianna Masciolini.

Repository: [UD_Greek-GLCII](https://github.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Greek-GLCII)<br />
Search this treebank on-line: [PML-TQ](https://lindat.mff.cuni.cz/services/pmltq/#!/treebank/udel_glcii218)<br />
Download all treebanks: [UD 2.18](/#download)

License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

Genre: learner-essays

Questions, comments?
General annotation questions (either Greek-specific or cross-linguistic) can be raised in the [main UD issue tracker](https://github.com/UniversalDependencies/docs/issues).
You can report bugs in this treebank in the [treebank-specific issue tracker on Github](https://github.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Greek-GLCII/issues).
If you want to collaborate, please contact [christinaklir&nbsp;(æt)&nbsp;gmail&nbsp;•&nbsp;com].
Development of the treebank happens directly in the UD repository, so you may submit bug fixes as pull requests against the dev branch.

| Annotation | Source |
|------------|--------|
| Lemmas | annotated manually |
| UPOS | annotated manually, natively in UD style |
| XPOS | not available |
| Features | assigned by a program, with some manual corrections, but not a full manual verification |
| Relations | annotated manually, natively in UD style |

## Description
A treebank based on version 2 of the Greek Learner Corpus (GLCII), consisting of written data produced by learners of Modern Greek.

<h2>Tokenization and Word Segmentation</h2>


<ul>
<li>This corpus contains 671 sentences, 9604 tokens and 9868 syntactic words.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>This corpus contains 1432 tokens (15%) that are not followed by a space.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>This corpus does not contain words with spaces.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>This corpus contains 19 types of words that contain both letters and punctuation. Examples: απ', κ.α, 'Αννα, 'Ολγα, E-MAIL, ΓΙ', Κ.πολη, Μπ., Ξ., Παρ', Ποστ-δοκ, ΥΠ", γιατρός-βιοχημικός, ξανά-πουν, πρωί-πρωί, σ’, τ', ό,, ό,τι</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>This corpus contains 264 multi-word tokens. On average, one multi-word token consists of 2.00 syntactic words.</li>
<li>There are 15 types of multi-word tokens. Examples: στο, στην, στη, στις, στον, στα, στους, στι, σην, στιν, στ', στης, στν, στούς, στόν.</li>
</ul>

<h2>Syntax</h2>

<h3>Auxiliary Verbs and Copula</h3>

<ul>
<li>This corpus uses 2 lemmas as copulas (<a>cop</a>). Examples: είμαι, sein.</li>
</ul>

<ul>
<li>This corpus uses 4 lemmas as auxiliaries (<a>aux</a>). Examples: να, θα, έχω, ας.</li>
</ul>

<h3>Relations Overview</h3>

<ul>
<li>This corpus uses 6 relation subtypes: <a>acl:relcl</a>, <a>csubj:pass</a>, <a>nmod:poss</a>, <a>nsubj:pass</a>, <a>obl:agent</a>, <a>obl:arg</a></li>
